Kroll Settlement Administration, part of Kroll’s Business Services division, is the leader in cutting-edge technology and consulting services for class action, mass tort, regulatory remediation and government claims administration. With 50+ years of legal administration expertise, we offer unmatched solutions and capacity for even the most complex settlements anywhere in the world.

As a settlement administrator, we are responsible for notifying potential class members, reviewing and processing claim forms filed by individuals and entities, calculating losses, auditing claims to determine the extent of the damages incurred and processing and distributing funds to eligible class members under the court’s direction. As part of Kroll, we employ nearly 5,000 professionals in 30 countries and territories around the world.

At Kroll, your work will help deliver clarity to our clients’ most complex governance, risk and transparency challenges. Apply now to join One team, One Kroll.

The Position

The Senior Analyst will join a case team, supporting a Manager and/or Senior Manager. Together, they will provide consistent superior client service. The ideal candidate will have excellent verbal and written communication skills, be consultative and solution-oriented and be capable of managing a budget and meeting deadlines. The Senior Analyst must be a team player, committed to contributing to a team environment and collaborating with team members (both in person and in remote environments) to provide the highest quality service to clients. All Kroll employees are expected to conduct themselves in accordance with the Kroll Values.

  • Project Execution – Proactively managing cases to meet and exceed project requirements and deadlines, within budget and at the highest quality standards. Effectively collaborates across the business to ensure timely execution and case management.

  • Research & Communication – Handle escalated claim inquiries and appropriately communicate findings with clients, claimants, managers and/or Senior Managers as needed. Identify and seeks to address process challenges and effectively communicates with project teams and vendors as necessary.

  • Reporting & Documentation - Review project reporting and summaries for accuracy and completeness to identify case-related issues to be addressed. Assist in development of business rules for claims processing and payments and ensuring related documentation accurately reflects requirements outlined in the applicable service agreement.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • College degree or comparable work experience required.

  • A minimum of 2 years’ experience working in claims administration, or a closely related field required.

  • Demonstrated experience working effectively in a team-based fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a professional, calm demeanor.

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate with professional clients.

  • Critical thinking and analytical skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively adhere to a budget and identify opportunities to enhance the client experience.

  • Demonstrated high proficiency in in MS Office Suite, particularly in Excel.

  • Understanding of data sets and data management concepts required.

Your recruiter will be happy to walk you through your U.S.-specific benefits, which include:

title: Senior Program Manager
description:
Who We Are

Provenir is the unified Decision Intelligence Platform that gives enterprises full control over end- to-end customer decisioning — to manage risk, drive growth, and transform business outcomes. By consolidating data, AI models, intelligence, agents and governance into a single decisioning environment, Provenir empowers business teams to configure and evolve strategy directly, while maintaining enterprise-grade reliability and regulatory compliance. Experience — 8+ years in Project Management, with a demonstrated track record delivering large-scale, complex software implementations for tier-one banks or other major financial institutions.

Education — Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience). PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification required.

Languages — Fluent English required; professional fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese would be a nice-to-have since there will be some cross-collaboration across teams.

  • Proven experience managing enterprise software implementations for tier-one banks, large financial institutions, or other highly regulated enterprises

  • Working knowledge of regulatory, compliance, and risk considerations relevant to banking and financial services technology

  • Excellent knowledge of MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint), MS Project, and Visio

  • Ability to prioritize, decide under ambiguity, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment

  • Excellent multi-tasking skills across several large, distinct projects or programs simultaneously

  • Strong appreciation of a range of technologies, including databases, and their implementation in a business environment

  • Expert knowledge of systems analysis, business analysis, requirements gathering, and project management techniques — with a proven record of applying them to complex business problems

  • Demonstrated experience owning or co-authoring SOWs, change orders, and scope/estimation documentation for enterprise engagements

Customer Relations Specialist

Richmond, VA

Urbanex is a rapidly growing, family and veteran-owned pest control company dedicated to

providing superior service and building a culture of growth, development, and teamwork.

From our humble beginnings in Nashville, Tennessee, in 2015, we're expanding to 14

locations across the country. We're not just about eliminating pests; we're about building

relationships and exceeding customer expectations. Our technicians are friendly,

courteous, and always go the extra mile, as evidenced by our customer testimonials.

At Urbanex, people are our most valuable asset. We invest in training, offer career

development opportunities, and foster a supportive, inclusive work environment where

everyone can thrive. If you're looking to join a company that values its employees and is

committed to making a difference for our customers, Urbanex might be the perfect fit for

you!


Our Core Values

• Play Like a Champion: We choose resilience, positivity, and determination, even when

it's hard. We find enjoyment and purpose in what we do to rise above, stay agile, and

pursue excellence in every situation.

• Unwavering Character: We choose to do the right thing, regardless of the

consequences. We always show up wholeheartedly, embracing vulnerability and

inspiring others by being a good person.

• Commit to Better: We wake up every day with the relentless desire to become better.

We face adversity head-on and inspire others to relate to challenges as opportunities for

growth.

• Wholehearted Connection: We root for one another in success and failure. We build a

community where everyone feels seen, supported, and valued. We meet people where

they are and believe building bridges is better than burning them.

• Belief is Contagious: We rise up by inspiring hope, giving people the freedom to

explore the journey of growth, and rewarding those with the courage to act on their

infinite potential,


About the Role

As a Customer Relations Specialist, you'll be the first point of contact for our customers at

our Nashville branch, playing a vital role in ensuring their satisfaction and

contributing to the branch's success. You will be a customer advocate, addressing

concerns, educating customers on our services, and ensuring they have a positive experience with Urbanex. This role requires a self-starter who can work autonomously,

manage their time effectively, and prioritize a broad set of responsibilities. You will need to

be reliable, honest, hardworking, and maintain a high level of professionalism in all

interactions. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential. This is

an in-office position.


Responsibilities

• Answer incoming calls with enthusiasm and professionalism.

• Schedule and reschedule service appointments, ensuring efficient routing and

technician availability.

• Process customer payments accurately and securely, maintaining detailed records

in our CRM system.

• Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries via phone, email, and

SMS.

• Proactively follow up with customers to ensure their satisfaction and address any

concerns.

• Educate customers about Urbanex's services, the importance of ongoing pest

control maintenance, and any available promotions.

• Collaborate with branch managers and technicians to coordinate service routes

and resolve customer issues efficiently.

• Handle customer retention tasks, including addressing concerns that might lead to

cancellations and proactively rescheduling appointments.

• Provide feedback to branch managers on customer trends and issues to help

improve service delivery and identify areas for growth.

• Assist branch managers with various tasks and projects as needed, demonstrating

flexibility and a willingness to support the team.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records in our CRM system.


Qualifications

• Strong customer service skills with a passion for helping others and resolving issues

effectively.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate

clearly and professionally.

• Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks

simultaneously, demonstrating strong time management and prioritization skills.

• Solid problem-solving abilities and a knack for finding creative solutions to

customer challenges.• A team player mentality with a willingness to collaborate and support colleagues in

a fast-paced environment.

• Self-starter with the ability to work autonomously and take initiative.

• Adaptability and a willingness to learn new systems and processes.

• A positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a desire to contribute to a growing

company.

• Proficiency in basic computer skills, including data entry and Microsoft Office Suite.

• Experience with FieldRoutes CRM and Voice for Pest phone systems is a plus, but

not required (we'll train you!).

• Must be reliable, honest, and able to maintain a high degree of professionalism at

all times.

• Must pass a background check and credit check due to the handling of customer

payments.


What We Offer

• Competitive pay ranging from $16 to $22 per hour, based on experience.

•Company-subsidized health, dental, and vision insurance with a generous employer contribution toward premiums, 3 weeks of PTO, 10 company-paid holidays, and your birthday off!

• Opportunity to work in a fast-growing company with a strong focus on employee

development.

• A supportive, team-oriented work environment where your contributions are valued.

• The chance to make a real difference in the lives of our customers by helping them

create a pest-free environment.


Why Urbanex?

Working at Urbanex means being part of a team that's passionate about protecting our

customers' homes and businesses from pests. It means having the opportunity to grow

your skills and advance your career in a supportive and dynamic environment. It means

making a difference in your community, one satisfied customer at a time.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Pharmacy
description:
Join Amazon Pharmacy's Fulfillment Product Tech team and shape the systems that determine how medications are dispensed, verified, and shipped to patients. You will execute the product roadmap to drive performance for the 1P Warehouse Management System (WMS) — the unified platform being built on AFT (Amazon Fulfillment Technologies) primitives to orchestrate pharmacy fulfillment within the four walls.
Pharmacy fulfillment is unlike retail: workflows span controlled substance compliance (DEA chain-of-custody), cold chain handling, pharmacist verification gates, and dynamic re-routing for problem states — all under HIPAA constraints. Every system you define and measure operates within these regulatory and operational realities, across small-format sites, regional fulfillment centers, and kiosks.
We are looking for a dynamic, analytically rigorous Senior Product Manager – Tech to own the product execution on how Amazon Pharmacy executes fill, verify, and pack — the core dispensing workflow that turns a prescription into a shipment. You will define the problems, shape the solutions, and drive outcomes across these domains — working directly with engineers building workcell execution services, operator tooling, and the hardware abstraction layers that connect our software to pharmacy automation


Key job responsibilities
1. Define and execute the roadmap for how prescriptions are dispensed, pharmacist-verified, and assembled into shipments across manual and automated workcells at all site formats (small-format, regional, kiosks).
2. Define and track metrics across the fill-verify-pack pipeline; identify bottlenecks, set targets, and partner with engineering to deliver measurable improvements in speed, accuracy, and cost-per-shipment.
3. Work with Hardware and Software Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Clinical Excellence, Finance, and In-Stock partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
4. Influence without authority across multiple teams and organizations to drive outcomes in a matrixed environment

You'll be responsible for establishing rapport with merchants to overcome objections and secure payment of debts.

title: Product Sourcer
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Washington D.C., London and Amsterdam.

Our EPD Recruiting team builds the teams that build Plaid. We partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, and Design to deliver thoughtful, candidate-first processes and continually raise the bar for how we scale. Within that, our team owns Product and Design recruiting. We are responsible for delivering world-class talent through pragmatic, data-informed, and principle-aligned recruiting practices that help Plaid scale with intention.

We are hiring a Senior Product Sourcer to support Plaid’s growing Product organization. Product Managers at Plaid are builders, thinkers, and connectors who shape how millions of people experience financial freedom — and this role is key to bringing that talent in.

As a senior sourcer, you will partner closely with Product leaders and recruiters to drive the top of funnel strategies for specialized and niche Product searches. You will own the research,, manage pipelines, guide hiring teams, and provide data-driven insights that help leaders make smarter hiring decisions. This is a high-impact, high-visibility opportunity where your work will directly influence how Plaid builds its product organization and scales to meet ambitious goals.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and manage pipelines of high-quality PM talent through creative sourcing, networking, and market mapping.

  • Track and analyze funnel metrics to identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to product recruiters and hiring managers, providing guidance on hiring strategy, talent market, and candidate experience.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other EPD recruiters and recruiting operations to drive consistency, share insights, and refine recruiting playbooks.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of technical sourcing/recruiting experience (in-house preferred).

  • Creative sourcing experience on multiple platforms and channels

  • Proven success partnering with senior PM or Engineering leaders on niche and challenging searches

  • Comfort working in a high-growth, fast-paced environment with multiple parallel searches.

  • Data-driven and process-oriented mindset; able to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.

  • Candidate-first philosophy; balances speed, quality, and experience.

  • Nice to have - fluency in Product Management disciplines (consumer, platform, growth, infrastructure, or API products)

  • Experience with longer term networking strategies (hosting events, dinners, conference strategies, etc)

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. We recognize that strong qualifications can come from both prior work experiences and lived experiences. We encourage you to apply to a role even if your experience doesn't fully match the job description. We are always looking for team members that will bring something unique to Plaid!

Plaid is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, ethnicity, religion or religious belief, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, military or veteran status, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Plaid is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance with your application or interviews due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations@plaid.com.

Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice here.

Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefit plans.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
About the Role

A well-funded, seed-stage startup building graph-native context and memory infrastructure for AI agents is hiring 2–3 Founding Engineers to work on the core platform. This is not a feature factory role. You will own significant pieces of the system — query engine, storage layer, graph internals — and make architecture decisions that will shape the product for the next decade. You'll work directly with the founding team, and your name will be on the design docs and the pull requests in the same week.

The company builds a GraphDB on object storage, purpose-built for modern AI workloads. The platform delivers precise, structured, and temporally-aware context to AI agents via a tiered storage architecture (in-memory, NVMe SSD, object storage), semantic search, git-style temporal versioning, and entity resolution. The company is backed by prominent investors and researchers in AI and infrastructure and has reached Series A/B-equivalent seed funding.

What You'll Do

  • Own and ship core infrastructure: query execution engine, graph storage layer, and distributed systems components

  • Make architecture decisions with long-term product impact alongside the founding team

  • Contribute to benchmark and research work that defines the technical category

  • Participate in architecture reviews and navigate hard technical trade-offs with real production consequences

  • Help raise the technical ceiling as the team scales

What We're Looking For

Dealbreakers (must-haves):

  • Proficiency in Rust or Go with hands-on experience building distributed systems

  • Experience designing and shipping core infrastructure components — query engine, storage layer, or graph internals — in a production environment

Required:

  • Strong CS fundamentals: ability to reason from first principles, not just frameworks

  • 3+ years of relevant engineering experience

  • Comfortable owning large, ambiguous problems without a playbook

  • Track record of shipping production systems that real customers depend on under load

  • Ownership mindset — ready to contribute to design docs and architecture decisions from day one

Nice to Have:

  • Experience building or scaling distributed databases or storage infrastructure

  • Open source contributions in systems-level projects

  • IIT or Recurse Center background

  • Prior founding engineer or early-stage infrastructure role

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $160,000 – $270,000 USD annually

  • Equity: Meaningful equity stake — the company strongly values builders owning a real piece of what they create

  • Wellness programs and free daily meals in-office

  • Top-tier hardware and software setup

  • Flexible PTO optimized for deep, focused work

  • Learning budget covering books, courses, conferences, and compute for personal experiments

  • Periodic team offsites

  • Visa sponsorship: Not available

Location

This role is on-site in San Francisco, CA. The team works in-person and values direct, high-bandwidth collaboration.

title: Instructional Designer II
description:
Compensation Type: Salaried

‎

Compensation: $67,320.00

‎

The Instructional Designer II (ID II) acts as project manager for multiple course design projects. This role forms and leads instructional design teams consisting of divisional staff members and subject matter experts, delegating work to ensure equal responsibility for timely, accurate, high-quality completion of course design and multimedia projects. The ID II chooses and applies appropriate instructional design principles, teaching strategies, and media formats to help develop written scripts/storyboards and transform them into clear, meaningful, engaging educational content for learners. This position stays current with digital design techniques and uses fundamental digital design principles to develop, illustrate, and produce complex visual representations (such as learning objects, course enhancements, eBooks, and video) through the mastery of key software programs and tools.

‎

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

Instructional Design Coordination:

  • Manages all processes and tasks related to the design and development of online courses according to the College’s development model. Evaluates and assists in the selection and creation of high-quality digital learning assets and eBooks for online learning programs. Identifies appropriate Digital Education & Instructional Services (DEIS) instructional design team for the course, develops complex digital content following faculty design directives, and follows the Digital Production Plan schedule and deadlines. Ensures course development is completed on time and within budget and meets standards of quality. Learns which internal and external stakeholders are involved in program development, then develops and maintains collaborative relationships with them.
  • Models leadership and professionalism in the development/design process, working with an instructional design team. Ensures that quality standards and the College’s vision and mission are reflected in all aspects of the student experience. Develops internal documentation around the theories and processes utilized in the design and development of degree programs.
  • Evaluates and enhances virtual testing processes for the College’s curriculum, ensuring clear guidance for students and faculty on setup, usage, and best practices. Maintains and updates supporting Blackboard content, ensures adoption across all relevant courses each semester, and provides assistance with clear, effective solutions to support a smooth and reliable testing experience.

Instructional Design:

  • Collaborates with subject matter experts to design instructional approaches to course “challenge points,” develops Digital Production Plan, writes scripts, creates storyboards, and works with instructional design team to produce digital learning assets (videos, learning objects, interactive activities, eBooks). Utilizes multiple approaches and modalities in learning in creation of effective digital content that is engaging and interactive, including competency-based learning, mastery learning, active learning and digital storytelling.
  • Applies web accessibility issues and copyright guidelines for all aspects of web courses. Researches and uses the latest techniques in studio and field video production, digital video capturing and editing, and instructional technology tools. Applies and implements evidence-based instructional/curricular development strategies for a given industry to create courses that represent the most current, research-based ideas in education.
  • Reviews and edits curricular materials, including competency statements, learning objectives, and assessments, to construct effective course curricula. Reviews current course of study learning resources and assessments to ensure proper alignment of curricula to the intended objectives.

Culture of Respect

  • Fosters and maintains a safe environment of respect and inclusion for faculty, staff, students, and members of the community.

MINIMUM EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Instructional Design, Curriculum, Technology or related field.
  • Three (3) years of experience with online learning technologies and pedagogies, and multimedia design development.
  • State Motor Vehicle Operator's License or demonstrable ability to gain access to work site(s).

This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Vice President, Mechanical Engineering- Building Systems for our Boston, MA Property and Buildings Office. This is an exciting opportunity for a licensed Mechanical Engineer with deep expertise in HVAC system design—particularly for complex healthcare environments and mixed-use commercial Facilities—who also understands the technical, regulatory, and operational challenges of such projects. The ideal candidate will have both technical leadership and some business development experience to help grow our Property and Buildings business.

This role will actively participate in the full project cycle with a focus on complex sector work such as healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, labs, Higher Education campus buildings, and mixed-use commercial projects from the design phase through final construction close‑out. Our Engineers work on high‑quality, high‑profile, local and national and projects with our practice providing design services for a variety of clients.

We are a global leader in the practice of mechanical, electrical, plumbing and fire protection engineering and related specialty services for the built environment. At WSP, we are driven by inspiring the right people to be part of our future‑focused business objectives. Our devotion to teamwork has allowed us to build communities and expand our skylines.

Here at WSP, anything is within our reach and yours as a WSP employee. Come join us and help shape the future!

Your Impact

  • Coordinate, review, and approve HVAC and mechanical system design plans, ensuring data integrity and compliance with all applicable mechanical codes, and industry standards such as ASHRAE and FGI Guidelines.
  • Apply high‑level mechanical and HVAC engineering techniques to identify system improvements across all project phases including concept development, preliminary design, final design, and general construction administration.
  • Plan and incorporate future‑ready HVAC strategies—such as energy‑efficient system architectures, decarbonization‑ready mechanical designs, and advanced ventilation airflow concepts—to ensure safety, resiliency, and optimal performance.
  • Oversee overall project HVAC system design and general consulting construction administration from project inception to completion, including air‑handling systems, chilled‑water/steam systems, hydronic piping distribution, specialized exhaust, and Building Control Systems – including application of industry expected sustainability concepts.
  • Oversee cross‑functional engineering teams executing project work on mid to high-level and/or multiple concurrent projects, including trade design budgets, tracking hours and expenses, task completion, technical HVAC calculations, code compliance documentation, and regulatory analysis.
  • Prepare data and visualizations such as HVAC load calculations, airflow diagrams, psychrometric analyses, system schematics, reports, and other illustrations for the interpretation or leading presentation of complex mechanical design concepts.
  • Prepare comprehensive technical reports and lead presentations that explain research, findings, system concepts, and recommendations to address HVAC design or construction issues and opportunities.
  • Manage client relationships and provide key technical input on business development and opportunity/pursuit efforts, particularly related to HVAC system design innovations and general marketing.
  • Develop relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, including client facility staff, manufacturer/vendor partners, colleague engineering staff, construction partners, and regulatory agencies.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision‑making regarding company funds, resources, and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, or closely related discipline.

  • 12+ years of relevant post‑education experience in mechanical and HVAC system design, including Healthcare, Lab, Higher Education, and Commercial environments.

  • Engineer license required (multi‑state preferred).

  • Extensive knowledge of HVAC system design, across multiple design sectors, including pressurization strategies, air‑change/ventilation requirements, humidity control, filtration standards, and specialized ventilation/exhaust systems.

  • Known in the local engineering community with a developed network (an extensive network preferred).

  • Proficient with HVAC engineering principles, design/bid traditional model, design/build delivery model, and application of mechanical systems to permitting and overall project‑related issues.

  • Experience with HVAC planning, system selection, load calculations, general energy modeling understanding, industry standard sustainability practices, and construction administration/management.

  • Well‑defined specific knowledge of relevant HVAC and mechanical construction laws, codes, regulations, compliance practices, and record‑keeping requirements.

  • Well‑developed ability to perform mechanical and HVAC system computations and calculations, interpret drawings and specifications, and compare conditions to current code and regulatory requirements.

  • Demonstrated effectiveness at coordinating and directing others to complete tasks safely and efficiently.

  • Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Business or Engineering.
  • LEED AP or WELL Certification.
  • At least 5+ years minimum of Project Management experience.
  • Basic First Aid and Adult CPR training desired.

WSP Benefits:

WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on a providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Tech Lead)
description:
Position Type: Full-time
Location: Boston-Based Hybrid
Work Authorization Requirement: Applicants must have permanent authorization to work in the United States and must not require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization. DealRoom does not sponsor or support work visas, student visas, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, or any other temporary employment authorization programs.

General Job Description

DealRoom is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to partner closely with a Product Manager and build a product end-to-end while staying hands-on in the code. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you will work hand-in-hand with a Product Manager to understand customer problems, shape technical solutions, and ship software that drives customer and business impact.

This is a builder-leader role, not a people-management role. You'll start as a two-person team with your PM, building hands-on: you set the technical bar, write code regularly, and turn a shared product direction into shipped software. As the product gains traction, this becomes the seed of a team you help grow and lead.

At DealRoom, engineers are builders who think in customer outcomes. You will spend time understanding the people who run M&A deals, turn that understanding into shippable software, and set the pace and quality bar for the product you and your PM own.

Who are we?

DealRoom is a dynamic FinTech innovator revolutionizing the Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) landscape. We're transforming complex financial processes with cutting-edge technology, and we're looking for passionate trailblazers to join our high-energy team. If you thrive on challenges and want to make a tangible impact in finance, DealRoom offers an exhilarating career launchpad. We're not just changing the game – we're redefining it.

Why was DealRoom started?

Founded in 2012 by former M&A advisor Kison Patel, DealRoom addresses technological gaps hindering deal success in the financial industry. With a client-oriented culture, DealRoom has grown to 50+ employees, remains self-funded, and is expanding rapidly. Our growth encompasses both DealRoom's software solutions and the M&A Science Podcast, which recently celebrated its 300th podcast episode!

Core Responsibilities

  • Partner day-to-day with your PM to learn from customers, shape solutions, and iterate quickly

  • Stay hands-on: write the code and own the technical execution of your product area

  • Own technical quality end-to-end through architecture, code review, testing, monitoring, rollback planning, and technical guidance

  • Adopt AI-native development practices to ship more with a small team

  • Help define and grow the engineering team as the product scales

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years building production systems, with strong backend architecture experience

  • Experience shipping production SaaS software end-to-end

  • Strong product sense and a genuine interest in partnering with Product, understanding customer problems directly, and communicating with customers, peers, and leadership rather than leaning on the PM

  • Clear judgment on when to move fast, when to invest in robustness, and when to simplify

  • Comfort working across the stack, including frontend, infrastructure, or tooling

  • High ownership mindset and ability to drive outcomes, not just output

Bonus Experience

  • Experience leading a team or major technical project

  • Experience mentoring engineers and reviewing others’ work

  • Experience with Python, Django, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, Vue, AWS, or similar technologies

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features

  • Ability to provide technical direction through architecture, code quality, delivery standards, and clear tradeoffs

  • Strong judgment on when an LLM is the right tool and when it is not

Why You’ll Thrive Here

You will thrive here if you are a strong engineer who still wants to be in the code. You think like a product person, ask why and for whom before jumping to how, and enjoy turning unclear problems into shipped software.

You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can pick a direction, ship something small, learn from real usage, and adjust.

You lead by example. Your influence comes from the quality of your thinking, the code you write, the standards you set, and the way you help the team deliver.

This Role May Not Be Right For You

This role may not be right if you want to stop coding and mainly manage people or a backlog. It may not be right if you need fully specced tickets before you can make progress, or if you are looking for a people-management role focused on career growth and performance reviews.

It may also not be right if you are uncomfortable shipping small, learning from customers, and improving through iteration, or if you would rather not lean on AI tools as part of how you build.

Benefits & Culture

  • Generous equity options

  • 100% individual / 60% family insurance coverage

  • Competitive benefits including 401(k)+matching, Healthcare, Dental, and Vision plans

  • $500 Annual AI Stipend

  • Learning and Development Support

  • Boston-based hybrid model (Tue, Wed, TH - In Office; Mon Fri WFH)

  • $300 Monthly Commute Stipend

  • Company paid laptop

  • DealRoom is committed to providing all team members a truly unique experience with the opportunity for involvement in all dimensions of running and growing our business.

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-moving, high-growth SaaS company

  • Experience working in an Agile development environment.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a diverse team.

Office environment. Requires ability to provide clear, concise, accurate and timely communication, both verbally and in writing (100%). Requires ability to use stairs or elevators for access between floors and multiple buildings at NASA and our facilities (10%).

Equipment and Machines:

Requires ability to operate a personal computer, a telephone, fax machine, copier, calculator, and other general office equipment (100%).

Normal workday 7:30-4:30, Monday thru Friday. Minimal overtime may be required (10%) to meet schedule milestones and to support technical demands of the job. Regular attendance is a necessity, and adequate arrangements for delegating duties during absences are required.

title: Director of Engineering (Contract, LATAM)
description:
About Nexus

Nexus is the engine for verifiable finance — a blockchain designed to natively embed the world’s financial system into one compounding system. Built to support every major financial market on a single global exchange, Nexus unifies infrastructure that has historically been fragmented across chains and intermediaries.

Headquartered in San Francisco with a growing presence in Buenos Aires, Nexus is proud to be a cross-continental team of engineers, cryptographers, and market builders. We’re investing deeply in the Latin American ecosystem — and always looking for world-class talent to join us.

Nexus is backed by leading investors, including Pantera, Lightspeed, Dragonfly, Faction, Blockchain Builders Fund, Alliance, and SVA, and works with more than 100 partners across the global finance and blockchain stack.

Location: Remote
Type: Full-time

The Role

You will own the engineering of the Nexus Exchange end-to-end — the matching engine, risk engine, settlement, data indexing and storage, the API/CLI/SDK surfaces, the oracle, and the infrastructure that runs it all. This is a money-handling domain where correctness, throughput, and tail latency are non-negotiable, and where breadth across many subsystems is the job. You’ll set direction and stay hands-on in the highest-leverage code.

This role anchors the Exchange Infrastructure specialization while carrying the full org-wide Head of Engineering mandate: own the architecture, lead the org, drive product and business outcomes, and make the team the most productive it can possibly be. We’re open to both experienced engineering leaders and rising leaders with outsized leadership ambition and the trajectory to back it.

What you’ll do

  • Own architecture across the Exchange domain — and stay hands-on, writing production code in the highest-leverage parts of the system.

  • Build the full Exchange and all its sub-components: matching engine, risk engine, settlement, data indexing, cold data storage, API / CLI / SDK, oracle, and the underlying infrastructure (Kubernetes, Terraform).

  • Lead the engineering org — senior engineers plus pods — managing timelines, roadmaps, and resourcing.

  • Drive product and customer outcomes, business-minded first; drive urgency and high-frequency iteration.

  • Make the org the most productive and efficient it can be.

  • Own end-to-end automation of engineering processes: agent infrastructure, logging, telemetry, observability — “closing the loop” with self-improvement loops and maximizing organizational context for agentic execution.

  • Design team structures and incentives with the CEO and exec team.

  • Manage an international, distributed workforce.

  • Drive quality infrastructure — telemetry, observability, and thorough automated testing (e2e, property, fuzz, invariants) — and set the bar for code review, on-call, and incident response, with particular rigor on money-handling paths. Correctness and performance should be continuously provable, not assumed.

  • Grow ICs and tech leads.

  • Communicate via design docs, RFCs, and post-mortems.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years building production software, including 2+ years in an engineering leadership capacity (tech lead / staff / principal / architect across multiple teams). Experience leading engineering orgs is important.

  • Proven high-throughput, low-latency systems experience and strong command of concurrent/parallel systems.

  • Deep hands-on stack fluency: Rust, Go, Next.js/TS or Node, GCP.

  • Architecture chops with sound correctness / latency / throughput / operability trade-offs.

  • Business-minded and outcome-driven.

  • Resilient and logical — clear-headed under pressure, reasons from first principles.

  • AI-forward: excited to use the latest AI tools and to push automation across the org.

  • Has mentored senior engineers and grown tech leads.

  • Fluent written and spoken English; async-first with meaningful US Pacific overlap (naturally strong for a U.S.-based hire).

  • Exchange-specific: deep exchange / trading-systems or comparable transaction-processing architecture; matching / risk / settlement correctness; market data (indexing, cold storage); API / SDK / CLI surfaces; oracle design.

Bonus points

  • Experience with exchanges / trading systems.

  • Standing up engineering practices (CI/CD, observability, on-call) in a fast-growing org.

  • Building automation / internal dev platforms / agentic workflow tooling.

  • Founding or early engineer at a high-velocity startup.

  • Open-source in Rust / Go / systems.

Our stack

  • Backend & systems: Rust, Go.

    Web & product surfaces: Next.js / TypeScript.

    Infrastructure: Google Cloud (GCE/GCP), containerized services, modern CI/CD, Terraform/Pulumi, Prometheus/Grafana.

PF Technologist assures quality control of equipment and follows standard guidelines to assure test validity before reporting to designated physician for interpretation. The PF Technologist may be experienced or entry-level registered respiratory therapist. The PF Lab Technologist will be expected to learn advanced testing procedures, monitor and implement changes within scope of practice and in consultation with physician(s).   • Maintains utmost level of confidentiality at all times.
  • Adheres to hospital policies and procedures.

Daily

  • Sets up and calibrates pulmonary function testing equipment using established guidelines, selects and tests equipment prior to patient use.

  • Maintains and troubleshoots pulmonary function testing equipment (follows established guidelines for operation, cleaning, storage, and disinfection, identifies and corrects malfunctions).

  • Evaluates validity of specific pulmonary function test, by assessing patient and equipment performance to ensure reproducibility; recognizes artifact and correctable problems.
  • Collects and evaluates clinical data; performs and evaluates quality control.
  • Calculates test results, evaluates reliability, compares results with predicted reference values, and evaluates clinical implications of test results.
  • Assists with parent and patient education in clinical and laboratory settings.
  • Assists with specimen collection for respiratory cultures using established guidelines.
  • Maintains clerical duties in accordance with the needs of the pulmonary function lab, including answering phones, scheduling appointments, faxing, and scanning of reports into patients’ electronic medical record.

Weekly

  • Checks and maintains special procedure gas, and supply inventories.

  • Assists with CF Center team duties

Biweekly

Monthly

  • Assists with preparation of monthly operations report.
  • Assists with preparation of monthly CQA/ CQI reports.
  • Assists with preparation of monthly infection control reports.
  • Attends monthly department meetings.
  • Assists team members with the education of physicians, nurses and respiratory therapists and volunteers with community education endeavors.

Annually

  • Assists with preparation of operations, quality assurance and quality improvement and infection control reports.
  • Assists with preparation of operations and capital equipment budgets.
  • Volunteers for hospital and community service.

Travel Requirements:

Travel destinations and frequency are subject to change in accordance with organizational needs. Must have reliable transportation.

title: Cybersecurity Specialist
description:
Career Area:

Technology, Digital and Data

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Qualys Platform Lead owns the administration, operation, governance, and continuous improvement of Caterpillar’s enterprise Qualys platform. This role provides technical leadership for vulnerability scanning, scanner appliances, Cloud Agents, platform configuration, asset data quality, reporting, integrations, and roadmap delivery across a global environment.

The role serves as the primary Qualys subject matter expert and works closely with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, ServiceNow, Governance and Compliance, and leadership teams to support effective vulnerability identification, prioritization, routing, and remediation coordination.

What You Will Do:

Platform Ownership & Administration

  • Manage platform configurations, scan profiles, scanner appliances, schedules, authentication records, asset tags, user access, and permissions, subscription usage, and operational health.

  • Ensure high availability, accuracy, and scalability of vulnerability scanning across enterprise-wide infrastructure and coordinate rescanning and validation activities as needed.

  • Maintain integrations between Qualys, ServiceNow, CMDB, cloud platforms, reporting systems, and approved security technologies.

  • Oversee host discovery, authenticated infrastructure scanning, scanner appliance operations, and Cloud Agent deployments.

  • Analyze vulnerability data to identify trends, coverage gaps, systemic issues, and areas requiring attention.

  • Support risk-based prioritization using Qualys Detection Scores, ETM and TruRisk capabilities, threat intelligence, exploitability, and asset context. Lead prioritization efforts using Caterpillar’s risk criteria and Qualys capabilities (e.g., TruRisk, Threat Protection, Patch Management modules if applicable).

  • Leverage AI-assisted security analytics and risk-scoring capabilities to improve vulnerability prioritization and remediation decision-making.

  • Evaluate and validate AI-generated insights from Qualys TruRisk, threat intelligence platforms, and security analytics tools to reduce false positives and focus remediation efforts on exploitable risks.

  • Utilize predictive analytics to identify emerging vulnerability trends, attack paths, and areas of heightened exposure.

  • Evaluate AI use cases and emerging technologies to improve operational efficiency, asset discovery, threat exposure analysis, and remediation effectiveness.

Governance, Reporting & Metrics

  • Work closely with Governance and Compliance teams to support audits, controls, and regulatory requirements.

  • Create, update, and maintain operational documentation, standards, and processes for vulnerability lifecycle management.

  • Assess and mitigate risks associated with AI-generated recommendations and automated remediation activities.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, and DevOps teams to drive remediation plans and support secure system configurations.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to IT partners, educating them on vulnerability risks, remediation techniques, and Qualys usage best practices.

  • Provide escalation support and root cause analysis for scan failures, agent issues, or false positives.

Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate and implement new Qualys modules, features, or scanning techniques aligned with Caterpillar’s security roadmap. ETM/TruRisk, CSAM (Asset Management), QPM (Patch Management) and QPA (Policy Control/Audit, EASM (Attack Surface Management).

  • Drive automation opportunities for asset onboarding, reporting, ticketing, and scanning workflows.

  • Identify process gaps and propose enhancements to strengthen vulnerability management maturity across the organization.

What You Have:

  • Vulnerability management and security operations expertise

  • Hands-on experience with Qualys or similar vulnerability management platforms

  • Vulnerability scanning, authenticated scans, Cloud Agents, and asset management

  • Knowledge of Windows, Linux, TCP/IP networking, AWS, and Azure

  • Experience analyzing vulnerability data, CVSS scores, and threat intelligence

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills

  • Familiarity with AI, machine learning, and predictive risk modeling

  • Experience using Microsoft Copilot, Security Copilot, or similar AI tools for security operations and reporting

  • Ability to collaborate across security, infrastructure, and application teams

Top Candidates Will Also Have:

  • Qualys Certifications (e.g., Qualys Vulnerability Management, Policy Compliance, Web Application Scanning, VMDR, CSAM, ETM, Cloud Agent, or EASM).

  • Experience with ITIL processes, ticketing platforms (ServiceNow, Remedy), and CI/CD pipelines as well as integrating Qualys with ServiceNow, CMDB, reporting, ticketing, cloud, or security platforms.

  • Experience with scripting for automation (Python, PowerShell).

  • Experience operating in large-scale, complex enterprise environments like Caterpillar.

  • Strong communication skills with ability to translate technical findings into actionable direction for non-technical teams.

Additional Info:

  • The ideal location for this role is East Peoria-IL, Irving-TX, Nashville-TN

About Caterpillar –

For more than a century, Caterpillar has helped build a better, more sustainable world. With 2025 sales and revenues of $67.6 billion, Caterpillar Inc. is shaping the future as the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. Backed by one of the largest independent global dealer networks and financing services through Cat Financial, the company’s primary business segments: Power & Energy, Construction Industries and Resource Industries are solving customers’ toughest challenges through commercial excellence and advanced technology, driven by a highly skilled, dedicated global team. title: Technical Program Manager – HHS
description:
We are seeking an experienced Technical Project/Program Manager who has successfully delivered complex technology programs within the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)—preferably supporting the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), National Institutes of Health (NIH), or Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

This is a delivery-first growth role designed for an accomplished program leader who has developed intimate knowledge of the HHS customer environment and aspires to expand into business development, capture, and customer engagement. The successful candidate will combine strong technical program delivery experience with an ability to identify customer needs, build trusted relationships, shape solutions, and help convert customer insight into qualified business opportunities.

We are looking for a credible practitioner who understands HHS missions, stakeholders, acquisition environments, technical challenges, and delivery expectations—and can use that experience to support the company’s growth within the federal health market.

Key Responsibilities

Program and Technical Delivery

  • Lead the delivery of complex IT modernization, software development, cloud, data, cybersecurity, digital services, or mission-support programs for HHS operating divisions.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for government program managers, contracting officials, technical leaders, product owners, and mission stakeholders.
  • Manage program scope, schedule, staffing, financial performance, risks, dependencies, quality, and contractual deliverables.
  • Translate agency mission and operational requirements into actionable technical strategies and delivery plans.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams that may include software engineers, cloud engineers, data specialists, cybersecurity professionals, business analysts, product managers, and subcontractor personnel.
  • Apply Agile, DevSecOps, product management, and human-centered delivery practices as appropriate.
  • Monitor program performance and proactively resolve delivery, staffing, customer-satisfaction, and contractual issues.
  • Maintain strong CPARS performance and identify opportunities to expand the scope and impact of existing customer engagements.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable HHS security, privacy, accessibility, records-management, and system-development requirements.

Customer Engagement and Business Development

  • Develop and maintain trusted relationships across CMS, NIH, CDC, and other relevant HHS operating divisions.
  • Maintain awareness of customer priorities, organizational changes, mission challenges, funding initiatives, acquisition strategies, and emerging technology needs.
  • Identify potential opportunities through customer engagement, program delivery, industry events, procurement forecasts, and agency acquisition activity.
  • Translate customer challenges into well-defined business opportunities, solution concepts, and pursuit recommendations.
  • Support customer call planning, capability briefings, industry-day participation, white papers, requests for information, and sources-sought responses.
  • Provide customer, competitive, incumbent, and acquisition intelligence to the growth and capture teams.
  • Participate in opportunity qualification, bid/no-bid decisions, capture planning, solution development, teaming discussions, and proposal reviews.
  • Help develop win themes, technical approaches, management solutions, staffing strategies, transition plans, and relevant past-performance narratives.
  • Collaborate with technology partners and prospective teammates to develop differentiated solutions for federal health customers.
  • Represent the company at HHS-focused conferences, industry associations, partner meetings, and customer-engagement activities.
  • Contribute to the development of a qualified and actionable HHS opportunity pipeline.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, public health, business, or a related discipline.
  • At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including technical project or program management.
  • At least five years of direct experience supporting HHS, with demonstrated knowledge of one or more of the following organizations:
    • Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
    • National Institutes of Health
    • Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
    • Other HHS operating or staff divisions
  • Demonstrated experience successfully delivering federal technology projects or programs within the HHS customer environment.
  • Strong understanding of HHS missions, organizational structures, stakeholders, acquisition processes, and technology priorities.
  • Experience managing technical teams, subcontractors, program financials, contractual deliverables, risks, and customer relationships.
  • Knowledge of federal technology environments, including one or more of the following:
    • Application modernization and software engineering
    • Cloud migration and cloud-native platforms
    • Data engineering, analytics, and artificial intelligence
    • Digital health or public-health systems
    • Cybersecurity and zero-trust architecture
    • Agile, DevSecOps, and product-centric delivery
    • IT operations and mission-system sustainment
  • Ability to communicate credibly with both senior government executives and technical delivery teams.
  • Demonstrated interest in developing business development, capture, and solutioning capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing professional relationships within CMS, NIH, CDC, or other HHS components.
  • Experience supporting CMS enterprise systems, Medicare or Medicaid programs, NIH research platforms, CDC public-health systems, grants-management programs, or HHS shared services.
  • Experience expanding an existing program, identifying adjacent opportunities, or supporting recompete and new-business pursuits.
  • Familiarity with federal procurement forecasts, SAM.gov, GSA acquisition vehicles, government-wide acquisition contracts, and HHS-specific contract vehicles.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

title: Technical Project Manager
location: DGS Philippines - Makati City - RCBC Plaza
description:
Job Description:

The Work:

The work is about making the business faster and freeing teams to do more — whether that’s a tool Finance uses to manage requisitions, a system that keeps timesheets compliant, or an agentic AI workflow that a delivery team uses to move faster. We’re actively ramping up our AI capabilities — agentic systems, machine learning, and AI-assisted operations — and this role will be at the center of managing that work.

As Technical Project Manager, you’ll run delivery across several of these programs at once, coordinating software engineers, data engineers, and analysts in a distributed team across the globe. You’ll be the person partners come to for a straight answer on where their project stands. And you’ll use AI yourself day to day — drafting, synthesizing, and thinking through plans so you can stay across the full slate.

What You'll Own:

Program Delivery

  • Own the delivery of multiple concurrent build programs — custom applications, workflow automations, data work, and AI-powered solutions including agentic and machine learning workstreams — from intake through deployment and real adoption. You hold scope, sequence, and dependencies, and you drive each program to a defined finish.
  • Run the day-to-day across a team spread over three time zones, keeping work moving instead of stalling until the next overlap window.

Partners & Communication

  • Be the bridge between the internal partners who own a process — Finance, Sales, Delivery, HR, Resource Management — and the team building the fix: keep both sides aligned, make sure the analysts get the access and decisions they need from the partner, and turn a status question into a current, accurate answer.
  • Run the delivery cadence (standups, working sessions, status) and hold contributors to their commitments across time zones.
  • Surface risk and slippage early, with a recommended path, before a date gets missed.

Process & Governance

  • Keep the portfolio honest in our portfolio-management tool: intake, scoping, scoring, and sequencing on a monthly nomination and six-week steering-committee cadence.
  • Design and keep sharpening how the team runs delivery — a modern, practical approach measured by what ships, not by how faithfully we follow a methodology. The process serves the work, never the reverse, and governance stays visible without becoming overhead.

What You Bring:

  • 3–7 years managing projects, with 2–4 years running software or application delivery specifically.
  • A record of running several delivery programs at once and driving them to closure — holding people to commitments, not only tracking tasks.
  • Enough technical fluency to move at a developer’s pace: you understand the software development lifecycle end to end — discovery, design, build, QA, release, and adoption — and know what your job is at each stage.
  • You don’t write the code, but you can run meetings, read a solution design, spot where integration risk sits, catch a padded estimate, and understand what a deployment involves — enough to ask the questions that matter.
  • Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.
  • Clear, direct communication that translates between technical teams and non-technical business partners.
  • You already use AI tools in your daily work — drafting status and communications, pulling a clear picture out of scattered notes, thinking through a plan — and you know where they help and where they don’t.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Athena Engine Front End
description:
Amazon Athena is an interactive query service that simplifies data analysis in Amazon S3 using standard SQL. Athena is serverless, so there is no infrastructure to set up or manage. Our customers use Athena to process logs, perform data analytics, and run interactive queries and get started quickly. This is all done through a simple, easy to use API in front of a complex, distributed system.

Every day, customers run millions of queries on Amazon Athena, from ad-hoc exploration to mission-critical pipelines. The Engine Front End team is responsible for the query lifecycle management and routing queries to the right engine with the optimal configuration. We are ultimately the bridge between the low-level execution engines that process data and the "magic" behind the Athena customer experience that makes it easy and simple to use for customers.

Key job responsibilities
Our ideal candidate has strong programming skills and sound judgment about distributed systems that customers depend on every day. As a senior engineer on the team you will own features and services end to end: shape designs, build, test, ship through our release pipelines, and operate what you ship in production. The problems are concrete and hard. Route millions of queries a day across engine generations without customers noticing. Prove a new engine build is safe before it takes production traffic. Keep the submission path fast and reliable while the engine underneath it changes. Everything you ship is exercised by every query Athena runs, so we care about engineers who sweat correctness, deployment safety, and failures that make sense to customers. We expect you to learn the system deeply, raise problems we have not spotted yet, and grow toward driving designs independently.

About the team
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Us

Nebulock is an agentic threat hunting platform that autonomously surfaces behaviors, not just IOCs, from various data sources. Nebulock acts like a teammate: a 24/7 AI threat hunter that investigates hypotheses, reasons through telemetry, and learns from an environment. Today, threat hunting is broken. Security teams spend weeks chasing alerts, writing detections by hand, and manually validating findings often just to confirm what their existing tools already flagged. Meanwhile, attackers exploit credentials, move laterally, and operate in silence. Nebulock flips the model. We continuously and autonomously hunt across endpoint, identity, and cloud telemetry. We identify the subtle behavioral signals that point to credential misuse, lateral movement, insider threats, and post-access activity. Then we turn those hunts into hardened, behavior-based detections automatically.

Position Overview

The Data Platform team is responsible for ingesting security telemetry data from our customers’ environments, transforming the data, and making it available to AI agents that continuously scan this data to look for malicious activities. We also tackle hard problems such as correlating entities across events from disparate sources and generating a queryable baseline view of activities that will allow agents to detect anomalies.

As a Senior Data Engineer on this team, you will own the core systems that form the foundation upon which Nebulock is built. You’ll co-own the data ingestion, transformation, and search layers that power agentic threat hunting workflows. We currently ingest terabytes of data per day and are growing fast. This role is ideal for engineers who love bringing clarity and order to messy, disparate, and large-scale datasets.

Expected Impact

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines that ingest and process large volumes of security telemetry (TBs / day)

  • Own API and event stream integrations across a wide range of third-party data sources (EDR, IAM, Cloud, SaaS)

  • Develop and maintain the transformation layer that turns disparate data into a normalized, enriched, and queryable model

  • Build an engine that correlates entities across disparate data sources

  • Work on core search capabilities across vast amounts of data

  • Collaborate with our internal detection engineers, threat hunters, and product engineers to ensure the data needs of Nebulock’s agentic threat hunting platform is met

  • Set and promote data engineering standards and best practices, including observability, monitoring and automated testing

  • Help drive the architecture and technical direction of Neublock’s platform

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience building data pipelines supporting customer-facing products

  • Experience with data warehousing technologies

  • Proficiency in Python, Java, Go, Rust, or similar

  • Hands-on experience with large-scale event streaming systems such as Kafka or similar

  • Experience with either AWS or GCP

  • Strong systems thinking and understanding of performance, cost and complexity trade-offs

  • Ability to adapt, iterate, and ship quickly

  • Hunger for growth and the desire to work in a low-ego environment

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with Clickhouse

  • Experience building or working with search systems over large datasets

  • DevOps or platform engineering experience

  • Cybersecurity experience

  • Startup experience

What We Offer

  • A dynamic startup environment with opportunities for rapid career growth

  • A collaborative culture that values innovation and creativity

  • Competitive salary and equity options

  • Comprehensive benefits package (including 401K)

  • Opportunities to travel for conferences, workshops, and team-building events

title: Lead Certified Outpatient Hospital/Facility Coding Specialist
description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

Responsible for primary diagnosis and procedural coding for designated ambulatory and hospital outpatient setting. Responsible for proficiently assigning proper and accurate medical codes for diagnosis, procedures, and services performed in an outpatient setting, such as but not limited to the following designated areas: emergency department, outpatient clinic, same day surgery, or diagnostic testing (radiology and laboratory). Typically reports to the Coding Manager.

Job Description

Minimum Qualifications

Education: High School Diploma or GED required; Associates degree in Health Information Management or any Healthcare Related Field preferred

Licenses/Certifications: Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), or relevant Coding Certification(s) from American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) or American Association of Professional Coders (AAPC) required.

Experience / Knowledge / Skills:

  • Six (6) years of hospital outpatient or ambulatory coding experience.

  • Experience coding in a level 1 trauma facility/academic teaching facility preferred.

  • Effective oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM and/or CPT coding.

  • Analytical skills necessary to interpret data contained in the health records and to assign appropriate codes.

  • Strong knowledge of human anatomy, physiology, medical terminology and surgical terminology.

  • Critical thinking, good judgment and decision-making skills.

  • Knowledge of coding compliance policies, official coding guidelines, regulatory requirements and internal policies and procedures affecting the coding process.

  • Proficient in navigating a Windows-based application environment.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Reviews medical record documentation to identify pertinent diagnosis/procedures that require code assignment for outpatient records and accurately code the diagnoses and procedures using ICD-10 coding conventions for the purpose of reimbursement, research, and compliance with federal regulations.

  • Reviews the medical record to assure specificity of diagnoses, procedures, and appropriate reimbursement for hospital and professional charges.

  • Queries physicians when code assignments are not straightforward or documentation in the record is inadequate, ambiguous, or unclear for coding purposes.

  • Keeps abreast of coding guidelines and reimbursement reporting guidelines and brings identified concerns to manager for resolution.

  • Effectively assigns ICD-10-CM, modifiers and HCPCS codes to outpatient records.

  • Responsible in maintaining 92% to 95% ICD-10-CM and/or HCPCS coding and consistently meet established productivity standards while keeping abstracting errors to a minimum.

  • Mentors and trains newly hired Coders and provides ongoing training of Coding staff.

  • Assists the Coding Manager with special coding assignments or coding tasks to resolve unbilled issues.

  • Serves as a resource for all coding related questions, responding in a timely manner to requests and questions from Coding staff.

  • Abides by the Standards of Ethical Coding as set forth by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) and adheres to official coding guidelines.

  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.

  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.

  • Other duties as assigned.
